title: Exponential Change and Separable Differential Equations
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

definitions.title: The Law of Exponential Change
definitions.statement: If the rate of change of a quantity y is directly proportional to y itself, then y grows (k > 0) or decays (k < 0) exponentially with time, where y_0 is the initial quantity.
conditions: k is a non-zero proportionality constant
definitions.explanation: Governs population growth, radioactive decay, continuously compounded interest, and Newton's Law of Cooling.
definitions.keyTakeaway: Proportional rate of change produces exponential dynamics.
